artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.6 × 6.8 cm (3 3/8 × 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy crowd surrounding a grand archway. The scene shows detailed architecture with people in motion, converging towards the arch. The arch is decorated with figures on top, suggesting a procession. The drawing captures a dynamic atmosphere with architectural elements and lively gestures. The style reflects a narrative focus on historical or ceremonial events in urban settings.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9 × 7 cm (3 9/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a chaotic siege scene at a medieval fortress. There is a large gathering of soldiers with spears and banners advancing towards the fortress. Soldiers are seen on foot and horseback, creating a sense of movement and urgency. A dilapidated wall and a tower are visible in the background, along with swirling clouds overhead. The artist has used intricate line work to convey details, creating a dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Raising of the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.7 × 6 cm (3 1/16 × 2 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The scene features a rocky landscape where a group of figures are engaged in the act of raising a cross with a figure attached to it. The composition is divided into two main sections: the foreground where a mass of spear-bearing figures is densely clustered, with some on horseback, and the elevated area in the background where the cross is being raised. The drawing captures a sense of movement and organization, suggesting a moment of intense activity. The use of lines is precise, giving a detailed depiction of the various elements and figures within the scene.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.7 × 6.1 cm (3 1/16 × 2 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a central figure on a cross with the inscription "INRI" above, surrounded by figures on either side who are also affixed to crosses. There is a large crowd gathered below, including figures on horseback, carrying banners and spears. Above the crucifixion scene, clouds emanate rays of light.

artworks.title: Noble Woman in Profile with her Hands in a Muff
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length side profile of a person standing with their hands clasped in front of them. The figure appears to be in a relaxed pose with the head slightly tilted upwards. The facial features are delicately drawn, with a slightly pointed nose and a serene expression. The person has neatly styled hair, mostly covered by a headpiece. The clothing is ornate and voluminous, featuring a long dress with exaggerated puffy sleeves and intricate detailing, alongside layers of fabric draping down to the ground. Around the individual's neck is a ruffled collar. The person is holding a fur muff in their hands. In the background, a town scene is visible, with various buildings, including a church and other structures, alongside small figures engaged in what appears to be a communal gathering. Trees are present, providing some greenery. The artwork emphasizes the person's prominence within the setting.

artworks.title: Noble Woman with Fan
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has a serene expression, small lips, wide eyes, and medium-length hair styled neatly. She is wearing an elaborate gown with intricate patterns, puffed sleeves, and a fur cuff. The dress has detailed embroidery, and she is wearing a necklace. She is holding a folded fan or similar object in her hands. In the background are a few buildings and small figures of people on the street.

artworks.title: Noble Man Wrapped in a Mantle Trimmed with Fur
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with hands covered by a fur-trimmed cloak draped around their shoulders. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, a pointed mustache, a small pointed beard, and long wavy hair. The person wears knee-length puffed pants, stockings, shoes with rosettes, and holds a long thin object by their side. The background depicts a village with multiple buildings, bridges over a river, trees, hills, and a clear sky.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Folded Hands
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in profile, facing left, with hands clasped in front at waist height. The person has distinct facial features, a pointed nose, pointed beard and mustache, and medium-length wavy hair. They wear an elaborate outfit with a wide-brimmed hat, fur-trimmed cloak, patterned vest, elaborate breeches, stockings, and patterned shoes. The background shows a detailed cityscape with buildings, an arched bridge over a canal, and small figures.

artworks.title: Noble Woman Wearing a Veil and a Dress Trimmed in Fur
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in full-body profile view facing right while holding a large textured object in front of them. Their facial features are detailed, with a serene expression, wearing a cap over short hair. They are dressed in a voluminous robe with fur trim and a long veil draped over their head and back, standing in front of quaint buildings and a church with a steeple. Groups of people are seen in the background walking along paths on either side of the person.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Fur Plastron
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their hands behind their back. The person has a long face, a pointed chin, and a mustache. They wear a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, a fur-lined cape, and cavalier-style clothing. A sword hangs from their side. The background depicts a town setting with various figures and buildings.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Mantle Trimmed in Fur,  Holding his Hands Behind his Back
artworks.description: The image displays a man walking in the foreground. He is shown in a side profile with one leg forward. He has exaggerated facial features, a hat with a feather, and is wearing a fur-trimmed coat and large boots. He is holding a sword at his side. The background shows a lively urban scene with buildings, trees, people, and a horse-drawn carriage.

artworks.title: Noble Woman with Large Collar
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length illustration of a person standing in an upright position. The person's facial features are delicately etched, with a composed expression, and their hair is styled in a neat manner that frames the face and extends slightly past the ears. They are wearing an elaborate outfit typical of a historical style, featuring a full skirt with intricate patterns, a fitted bodice with puffed sleeves, and a large, detailed collar. The person appears to be holding a fan in one hand. In the background, there is a detailed scene depicting a landscape with several buildings, trees, and individuals engaging in various activities.

artworks.title: The Triumph of the Virgin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 57.3 × 37.8 cm (22 9/16 × 14 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial scene with figures and fantastical elements. The detailed linework shows robed figures around a central chariot, with banners and symbolic motifs. The scene includes a landscape with a castle and ships in the background, under a sky with swirling figures and clouds. The work features text elements that seem to be part of the narrative or context of the scene, resembling a detailed tapestry of historical or allegorical significance. The composition is detailed, with attention to the drapery and posture of each figure, conveying grandeur and formality typical of classical allegorical illustrations.

artworks.title: Saint John on the Isle of Patmos
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated outdoors. He has a calm expression and short, neatly styled hair. He is wearing flowing robes and holds a rolled scroll. The background features rocks, trees, a building, water, and a cityscape. An angelic figure with wings blows a trumpet in the sky. The scene is detailed with movement in the clouds and water.

artworks.title: Pandora
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a unique perspective capturing both earthly and celestial elements. The horizon divides the composition, displaying a cityscape with towers in the distance. The upper half features a sky filled with swirling clouds. The etching technique is used with sharp lines for detailed depiction. The monochromatic color palette focuses on black and white tones, emphasizing contrast. The central figure holds a torch amidst other figures and mythological elements in the clouds.

artworks.title: The Cult of God
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene in a grand architectural setting. The depiction shows the interior of a large, vaulted structure with people kneeling and engaging in various activities around an altar. The high, arched ceilings are supported by massive, elaborate columns. At the center of the image, an altar is adorned with ornamental objects and shaded by a canopy. The figures are arranged around the altar, some in prayerful poses. The composition is detailed, with linear hatching techniques used to create depth and texture, characteristic of classical or baroque drawing styles.

artworks.title: The Cult of the Demon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a goat-like creature. In the foreground, there are humanoid figures with exaggerated features in a cavernous setting. The central focus is a large goat with prominent horns perched atop a rock formation, overseeing the activities below. The setting is shaded with cross-hatching, creating depth. Shadows and lines create movement and energy. The composition evokes themes of mythology and ritual, with the goat possibly symbolizing a deity or mystical figure.

artworks.title: The Cult of Men
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural scene with figures in robes. The image depicts an interior space featuring a seated figure on an ornate chair or throne under a canopy. The architecture is intricate, with columns, arches, and a detailed backdrop of classical buildings, including an obelisk in the distance. The figures in the foreground are dressed in draped garments, and their postures suggest that they are either approaching or communicating with the seated figure. The presence of detailed cross-hatching and high contrast in the line work suggests a mastery of light and shadow, capturing a scene rich in narrative potential and historical reference.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricately detailed etching featuring a mythical or classical scene set within an oval frame. Figures are shown in various states of movement and action, with one central figure appearing to rise or descend in a burst of light. Classical architectural structures like columns are present, and a backdrop of smaller robed figures suggests a gathering or ceremonial event. Celestial or divine figures hover above in a sky adorned with clouds and rays of light. The composition is busy and intricate, with many figures and architectural details creating a visual narrative.

artworks.title: The Apostle Peter
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing and reading a book. He has a beard, furrowed brows, long wavy hair, and wears a long robe with a large key hanging from his waist. A halo is above his head. The background features several figures engaged in different activities, including a group near water and another group on a rocky landscape. The sky has clouds and rays.

artworks.title: The Card Players
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group around a table engaging in leisure activities. The image depicts various objects and figures positioned around a central table. The table is covered with items such as coins and a deck of cards. A candle holder with a burning candle is placed at the center of the table. The setting is intimate and crowded, with figures surrounding the table. One figure is playing a musical instrument. The figures are dressed in elaborate attire. The scene is enclosed within an oval border with an inscription.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms of Nicolas Francis of Lorraine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms design. The drawing features a shield divided into multiple sections with different symbols such as lines, crosses, stars, and floral emblems. Above the shield is a crowned hat with intricate patterns and tassels. Flanking the shield are two winged cherubs, one holding a staff with a curled top, and the other appearing near an ecclesiastical hat. The composition is symmetrical and includes decorative elements like scrolls and leafy branches.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Light of the Cloister"
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a religious scene with symbolic virtues. The central figure is kneeling and holding a cross. Above, a heavenly figure with angels appears to be blessing the scene. Two robed figures stand on each side, one holding a staff with a lily. The words "LUX CLAUSTRI" are shown in the sky, under which are inscriptions for "Obedientia," "Paupertas," and "Castitas", translating to obedience, poverty, and chastity. Detailed shading and line work give the illustration depth and drama, typical of etching style associated with Jacques Callot.

artworks.title: The Vigilant Eye
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rolling hills, a village, trees, buildings, and a sky with clouds. In the foreground, there are fences, sheep, and a resting cow. The scene is rendered in fine lines and crosshatching, creating a monochromatic composition with texture and depth.
